symptom: A business event message's `TaskId: String(36)` / `Text: String(unlimited)` passed check and was stored with no Length, so mx check 11.12.6 reported 'The max length of the attribute ... is different between the business event and the entity' (4x). describe printed `String` with no length, and a message declared once per operation (publish, then subscribe) described both as the later operation.
file: mdl/visitor/visitor_businessevents.go (LPAREN length), mdl/backend/modelsdk/business_event_write.go (Length), integration_read.go storedStringLength, mdl/executor/cmd_businessevents.go (businessEventAttrTypeText, nextOp). Tests: mdl/executor/business_event_lengths_2490_test.go, mdl/backend/modelsdk/business_event_lengths_2490_test.go
cause: The visitor reduced the data type to a bare name (dataTypeSimpleName), so the length never reached the model; describe keyed operations by message name, so the later of two same-named operations won.
insight: **An absent property and its zero value are different facts.** buildDataType gives 0 for both a bare String and String(unlimited), and the gen accessor gives 0 both for Length=0 and for no Length key; the build reads the absent one as 200. Distinguish stated from unstated at the parser (LPAREN) and the stored key at the raw document, and write nothing when nothing was stated, or every script that paired a bare String with a String(200) entity attribute breaks. Re-running the describe output of a same-named double declaration still re-mints the second channel's ChannelName (channels are carried by message name): part 1 of the issue, which replaces that shape.
